name: rexplayer
tagline: Every file, stream and disc. A Windows media player built from scratch.
description:
A Windows media player whose engine is REX code: format readers that recognise media by its bytes, a media session with a single-threaded command mailbox and sample-accurate seeking, its own MP3 and FLAC decoders, gapless playback, its own resampler and channel mixer, and Windows audio through WASAPI. Patented codecs decode through Windows; everything else is written here.

Every line of the engine is covered by tests on each change, including exact-sample checks of what was played, and the command line prints one JSON document per command for scripts and agents.
highlights: Its own engine: format readers, media session, resampler and mixer
Sample-accurate seeking that interrupts whatever the pipeline was doing
Every engine line covered by tests on each change
A command line that prints one JSON document per command
